item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Discographies in TIDAL MASTER Quality
item.description:
So, as all you know... Tidal has removed almost every MQA file.

There's an user in this forum named Cheems, who uploaded a bunch of full discographies by many artists. And most of the albums were in MQA.
Sadly, his/her Drive account was shut down, and all the files are lost.

If any of you were able to download full discographies of many artists, I'd like you to please reply this post and share some of the albums here... Maybe not the whole discographies, but some albums or releases that are very requested.

In my case, I was looking for Madonna's and Dua Lipa's MQA discographies. If You could help me with those i'll be grateful . Stay amazing ✌
